name: Data.enough_forms
summary: Few translates of the filling maps nearly span the rows.

steps.claim: The columns form a non-zero space (their coordinates are non-trivial).

0 < dim Column(D) (non-zero finite-dimensional); 0 < dim rows(D) (`Data.finrank_rows_ne_zero`); and `exists_few_translates` for the maps |𝖦|e₀s∘𝒫_D∘(c_D·E) (W = rows, η = b_D^(−2) > 0), which are spread by the filling theorem (`Data.ramifiedColumns_fill_rows`), gives t with #t·dim Column(D) ≤ 5·dim rows(D)·log(1 + b_D²) and dim ∑_{s∈t} range ≥ (1 − 4/b_D²)·dim rows(D); each of these ranges lies in range P_{D,s} (c_D·E(φ) is c_D times a ramified column), so the sum of the ranges of the P_{D,s} is at least as large.
steps.lean:
⟨finrank_pos, D.finrank_rows_ne_zero.pos, (exists_few_translates (W :=
    D.rows) (HasLogBound.pos D) (D.ramifiedColumns_fill_rows _)).imp fun _ ↦ .imp (by simp)
    (·.trans (mod_cast finrank_mono (iSup₂_mono fun _ _ _ ⟨φ, e⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨_, φ, rfl⟩, e⟩)))⟩
